name: Command palette
description: A searchable list of every page and action, opened with ⌘K or Ctrl+K and driven from the keyboard.

props.name: children
props.description: CommandGroup and CommandItem elements.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the item's id when it is chosen. The palette then closes.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Inside a DialogTrigger it follows the trigger instead.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open state on first render (uncontrolled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the palette opens or closes.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: The key that opens and closes the palette with ⌘ or Ctrl. Null turns the shortcut off.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search row.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Defaults to a short message naming the query.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The query (controlled). Use defaultInputValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called as the query changes.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked. Escape clears the query first, then closes.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the dialog.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes for the scrim.

props.name: children
props.description: CommandGroup and CommandItem elements.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the item's id when it is chosen.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search row.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when nothing matches.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The query (controlled). Use defaultInputValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called as the query changes.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the search row on mount.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the list of results.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel, e.g. a width. It is at most 560 pixels wide.

props.name: title
props.description: A small heading over the group. Groups with no matches are hidden while filtering.

props.name: children
props.description: CommandItem elements.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Matched against the query.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the item in onAction.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16 pixel icon before the label.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Key hint at the end of the row. Separate keys with spaces, e.g. "⌘ ⇧ L".

props.name: keywords
props.description: Extra words that also match, e.g. ["dark", "light"] for a theme switch.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text to match when the label is not a plain string.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the item is chosen.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the item a link.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the item.
